layer_1_style.description: High-poly 3D animation style, cinematic CGI, smooth clay textures, soft studio lighting, tactile 'handmade' feel.

layer_3_action.subject: Tyrannosaurid vestigial arm morphology
features: Two tiny, comical clay arms positioned on the front of a large theropod torso
Each arm has two small, sharp white clay claws
The arms are made of textured reddish-brown clay with soft muscle definition
The hands are slightly curled in a playful, 'reaching' pose
The surrounding body is out of focus to keep the emphasis entirely on the small scale of the limbs
layer_3_action.action: A centered, cinematic macro shot of the tiny clay arms. The lighting is soft and warm, highlighting the 'squishy' and tactile clay textures. This serves as a 'Tiny Arms' morphology icon for a children's game. No text.
